One thing found

The attendance list does not update by itself. When Asha signed in, the server marked her present straight away, but the teacher's Today screen still showed "0 of 2 present" until he went to another screen and came back. The poll count on the same screen did update by itself. The data is right; only the screen is late. It is in apps/client/src/features/attendance/AttendancePanel.tsx.

Super Admin

  • Signed in as admin. The top bar says "Super Admin".
  • Opened all 6 screens: Today, Teach, Videos, Reports, School, System. No errors on any of them.
  • Added Class 8, then added the student Bala Jadhav (roll 2) to Class 7. Both showed in the list at once.
  • The activity log on the System screen listed each action.

Teacher

  • Signed in as ravi (Ravi K, Class 7, Maths). The top bar says "Teacher".
  • Has 5 screens: Today, Teach, Videos, Reports, School. There is no System screen.
  • On School he sees the timetable, his students and the devices. Adding teachers and adding classes are not there.
  • On Reports, "What teachers have done" is not there.
  • Asked the poll "Was today's lesson easy to follow?" with Yes and No. After the student answered, his screen showed "Yes 1, No 0, 1 answer" by itself.
  • Pressed "Lock all screens". The student's screen was covered. Pressed "Unlock all screens". It opened again.

Student

  • On a lab PC, picked Class 7, typed roll 1, and said "Yes, that is me" to "Are you Asha Patil?".
  • The teacher's poll was on her home screen at once. She pressed Yes, and it went away.
  • Opened all 8 screens: Home, Things to do, My books, Videos, My work, How I am doing, My notes, Settings. No errors.
  • Pressed मराठी: the menu and labels changed to Marathi. Pressed English: they changed back.
  • When the teacher locked the lab, her screen said "Look at your teacher". It opened again on unlock.
  • A second sign-in as the same student on another PC was refused: "already signed in on Lab PC 3. Sign out there first."

Not tried

  • Real Windows PCs. All of this ran on the Mac. The app ran in a browser stand-in, not in the installed Windows app.
  • The smart board role.
  • Quizzes, videos, books, office files, activities, AI lesson plans and showing to the class. The automatic tests cover them, but they were not walked through on screen in this run.
